Title: What is our team's primary value proposition?
Detail_lesson: Teams must identify and align on their unique contribution to the organization. What specific value do we deliver that no other team does?
CustomInstruction: Consider both tangible deliverables and intangible benefits. Think about what would be missing if your team didn't exist.

Title: How will we measure success in 12 months?
Detail_lesson: Define specific, measurable outcomes that will indicate the team has succeeded in its mission.
CustomInstruction: Focus on metrics that are within the team's control and align with organizational objectives. Consider both quantitative and qualitative measures.

Title: What are our non-negotiable working principles?
Detail_lesson: Establish the fundamental rules and behaviors that will govern how the team works together.
CustomInstruction: Think about past experiences, both positive and negative, and what behaviors consistently led to success or failure.

Title: How will we handle disagreements and conflicts?
Detail_lesson: Define the process for addressing and resolving conflicts within the team.
CustomInstruction: Consider different types of conflicts (technical, interpersonal, strategic) and what escalation paths make sense for each.

Title: What skills gaps must we fill to achieve our goals?
Detail_lesson: Identify critical capabilities needed for success and current team limitations.
CustomInstruction: Consider both technical and soft skills. Think about future challenges, not just current needs.
